- Target audience: platform engineers, ML infra leads (APAC/US waves)
- Date window: July 20–30 (we can flex to your preferred week)
- Format: 30 min joint presentation + live demo + 15 min live Q&A

Doable? If so I can loop in Marissa (events ops) and Mateo (partner comms) to lock the dates and draft the RSVP drip.
